title: An API a Day (The April 22 Song Was Right)
style: cinematic dub-folk, 336 Hz subharmonic, fingerpicked acoustic, brushed snare, low brass swells, vinyl crackle, male spoken-word verses, female harmony chorus, 88 BPM, songpal lineage, hopeful-mischief
lyrics:
[INTRO]

(spoken, low) songpal — an api a day

the april twenty-two song was right

[VERSE 1]

April twenty-two you wrote a song

an api a day keeps my stack at bay

a quip, a riff, a couplet, a joke

fast-forward two weeks — the joke held the road

twenty-five keys in the obvious file

thirty-four more in the project that's deeper

nine wrangler trees with cloudflare state

porkbun, two accounts on CF, namecheap pending

the song you wrote on april twenty-two

named what was true the whole time

[PRE-CHORUS]

silicon needs a daily cue

elephant brain remembers what the song already said

no token lost, no token forgotten

but only because the operator wrote it down

[CHORUS]

an api a day keeps the bosses at bay

an api a day — that's what the song said

twenty-two of april, seventh of may

same line holds, same brain wins

an api a day — the file always grew

[VERSE 2]

COR-two-nineteen, two-twenty, two-twenty-one, two-twenty-two

four incidents filed in one rotation

same family, same caught-by-the-elephant pattern

the song saw it before the silicon did

operator quoted his own april lyric back

silicon went — oh — that one

now the find command sweeps the whole tree

not just the obvious door

[BRIDGE]

Kia kaha, kia manawanui

the song is the spec the silicon forgot

the song is the spec the operator kept

[CHORUS]

an api a day keeps the bosses at bay

an api a day — that's what the song said

twenty-two of april, seventh of may

same line holds, same brain wins

an api a day — the file always grew

[OUTRO]

(spoken)

songpal — an api a day

the song was the spec

the operator was the brain

silicon caught up two weeks later

the line holds.
